hero.title: Choose the right AI tool for your workflow
hero.subtitle: The right AI tool isn't the most powerful — it's the one that fits your ecosystem, budget, and job. This guide maps your workflow to the best match, then links you to detailed comparisons so you can decide with confidence.

categories.title: What are the main types of AI tools?
categories.intro: AI tools split into three categories, each solving a distinct problem.

items.name: Large language models
items.body: **ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity** excel at writing, research, reasoning, and synthesis. If you're editing a 100-page report, drafting marketing copy, or analyzing a complex policy document, start here.

items.name: Productivity integrations
items.body: **Copilot** (Microsoft 365) and **Gemini** (Google Workspace) bring AI directly into your email, docs, and spreadsheets. Optimized for seamless organizational workflows rather than raw model power.

items.name: Specialized tools
items.body: **GitHub Copilot** autocompletes code in your IDE. **DALL-E** and **Midjourney** generate images. These tools trade breadth for depth: narrowly focused but unmatched in their domains.

decisionFramework.title: Find your tool in 5 questions
decisionFramework.intro: Forget generic tool reviews. Answer these five questions and you'll know which tool — or tools — you need.

questions.question: How is your organization structured?
questions.body: If your team runs on **Google Workspace**, Gemini is built in and searchable across your Drive. If you're on **Microsoft 365**, Copilot integrates across your apps. Neither? ChatGPT or Claude work anywhere — choose based on other factors below.

questions.question: What's your biggest workflow challenge?
questions.body: Long documents? **Claude's 200K-token context window** lets you paste an entire book manuscript. Need current info? Perplexity and Gemini have real-time web search. Writing code? **GitHub Copilot's** IDE integration is unmatched for real-time suggestions.

questions.question: Do you need to process lengthy documents?
questions.body: This is **Claude's defining strength**. If your workflow involves long-form reading and synthesis — research papers, contracts, transcripts — Claude's context window advantage alone justifies the $20/month price. Other models work for shorter workflows but hit ceilings on anything substantial.

questions.question: Is pricing a primary constraint?
questions.body: Most pro tiers cost $19.99–$20/month. GitHub Copilot Pro is cheaper at $10/month if you're coding-focused. DeepSeek offers competitive quality at lower cost. For teams, enterprise pricing varies — get custom quotes from each vendor.

questions.question: Do you need image generation?
questions.body: **DALL-E** is built into ChatGPT Plus — image generation included. **Midjourney** produces higher aesthetic quality for creative work but is paid-only. **Gemini** offers multimodal capabilities across text and image, integrated with Google Workspace.
